Was your sister experienced?) - **Outcome** (did your action prevent harm or cause unnecessary distress?) In many cases, **ethical decisions balance care and communication**—if you had told your sister, *"Hey, that ladder looks shaky—let’s check it together,"* it might have been a better approach. But if it was an emergency, your quick action could be seen as **right in the moment**. Would you say your sister was aware of the risks, or was this more of a spontaneous reaction? That could shift the moral weight!
